status: secondary comparative-analysis addendum fixed before new execution, informed by R4 PDF reviews and earlier corpus inspection
scope: Exactly the retained public 89-cell/623-row numeric matrix and frozen 35 retrospective choices. Zero new GPU/source acquisitions. This does not repair order randomization or untouched-policy-test gaps.

models.linear_slope: x_p=theta_p+alpha*j_p, |alpha|<=delta. Independent summary log intervals. Pair supports equal the flexible path supports, but one common slope must satisfy ALL candidate-winner inequalities simultaneously. A candidate is possible iff [-delta,delta] intersects all lower/upper slope half-lines from log(Lp/Uq)<=alpha*(jp-jq).
models.shared_path: Existing adjacent-increment bounded bias path b0=0, |b_(j+1)-b_j|<=delta. Sharp distinct-pair support log(Up/Lq)+delta*|jp-jq|; self exactly0.
models.independent_marginals: Forget only path correlation: independent bp in [-jp*delta,jp*delta], with EXACTLY the position-wise marginal ranges of the anchored shared path. Sharp distinct-pair support log(Up/Lq)+delta*(jp+jq); self exactly0. This is a relaxation, not evidence either model is physically valid.
models.path_plus_arm_residual: x_p=theta_p+b_jp+e_p with the existing shared path and independent e_p in [-gamma,gamma]. Distinct-pair supports add2*gamma; self remains0. Possible-winner inequalities subtract2*gamma from log(Lp/Uq). This explicitly checks bounded violation of the common-path-only structure, without calibrating gamma.

parameterization: delta=log1p(f); gamma=log1p(g). Residual log range corresponds to multiplicative [1/(1+g),1+g], NOT [1-g,1+g]. No grid budget is inferred true.
comparisons: All cells, pattern and C8 subgroups: unique and possible-winner counts, full possible sets, and fixed original-choice admitted19/all35 regret ratios. Matched path/marginal comparisons use the SAME summary rectangle, budgets and zero self terms. Report minimax descriptive choices only as all-arm audits. Linear/path pair supports and worst regrets MUST agree, even if possible-winner sets differ; count these differences explicitly.
radii: For each strictly separated nominal minimum, retain its limiting rival and critical delta. At fixed delta=log1p(.02), the residual log-radius is -0.5*max distinct-rival path support when positive. Report min/median/max, counts below each declared residual budget, all rows, and deterministic three smallest/three largest positive radii with configuration identities, not selected favorable examples.
controlled_fixtures: A three-arm point fixture at positions1/2/3, log costs0/.01/0 and delta=.01: the middle candidate is possible under the flexible path but impossible under ANY linear slope, despite equal pair supports/regret. A six-arm misspecification fixture has point log costs P0,F.03,others1; delta=.002 and gamma=.011. The path-only set uniquely guarantees P, while a declared residual witness reverses P/F. These are mathematical fixtures, not device experiments.
independent_checks: At delta=log1p(.02), formulate independent LPs for linear slope, independent marginals and shared path plus gamma=log1p(.005), all89 cells. Optimize every ordered distinct pair and check each of six possible-winner feasibility systems:8010 pair LPs and1602 candidate LPs. Keep exact input hashes and full results; use numerical tolerance only for LP comparisons, not to infer physical validation.
scientific_boundary: This measures the information consequence of supplied uncertainty structures and controlled mathematical model violations. It is not statistical confidence, measured order/carryover, a validated physical bias bound, corrected hardware costs, native causal identification or a prospective deployed selector. Broad robust-regret/possible-optimality concepts are established prior work.
